title: Linux CLI & Bash Scripting
description: Navigate Linux servers with confidence. Master files, permissions (chmod), pipes, grep/awk/sed text processing, systemd processes, and safe Bash scripts.
prerequisites: None, essential for backend and DevOps engineers
outcomes: Navigate directories, inspect files, and copy/move assets fluently in the shell
Compose powerful pipelines with |, >, grep, sort, uniq, and wc
Understand Unix file permissions (rwx, 755, 644, 600) and chmod
Inspect running processes, ports, and disk/memory usage on Linux servers
Write defensive Bash scripts using set -euo pipefail, variables, and loops
